description:
## [1.22.0-dev.1](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.21.0...v1.22.0-dev.1) (2026-11-28)

### Kick

#### ✨ New Features

* **Hide chat highlights** can hide the gift leaderboard line

#### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support Kick 40.35.7

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Anonymous chat** says why a message wasn't sent
* the 7TV emote connection survives an error message
* **Third-party emotes:** a 7TV name typed as :name: is sent as the word

### Rumble

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Video info while paused**

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Sleep timer** no longer starts over when the stream buffers

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Compact stream info**
* add **Hide chat header and input**
* add **Hold to delete in emote picker**
* Favorite emotes can be added from the sheet of an emote tapped in chat
* **Hide player buttons** can hide the landscape chat mode button or keep it to the selected modes

#### 🚀 Updated App Support

* support Twitch 32.2.0

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* 7TV badges keep arriving after a channel switch
* a JavaScript bundle that can't be prepared is reported
* **Chat overlay** keeps showing display names
* **Emote and badge info** no longer fetches Twitch's images as Lurk
* Hide Live tab marks Following in Home's loading placeholder again
* Lurk's own requests no longer use Twitch's cookie jar
* the navigation button hider stops working on every layout pass

### Shared

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* a **sleep timer** pause that fails no longer stops the app
* always-on log lines no longer name what is being watched
* Pause Lurk covers choices, the **sleep timer** follows the settings screen
* small hardening found while reading the audit's unverified items
* swipe brightness is handed back in landscape too
* the notice that Lurk paused itself fits a toast
